children: Compass Therapeutics said the FDA recommended conducting a trial demonstrating a survival benefit before submitting a BLA for tovecimig in previously treated biliary tract cancer.
FDA recommended a confirmatory survival trial prior to a BLA for tovecimig in previously treated advanced BTC.
Compass disagrees that a new trial is warranted based on COMPANION-002 data and the urgent unmet need.
COMPANION-002 showed significant improvements in ORR (18.0% vs. 5.3%, p=0.0228) and PFS (median 4.7 vs. 2.6 months; HR 0.44, p<0.0001).
Overall survival analyses were confounded by high crossover and prolonged survival in crossover patients and did not meet significance.
Compass intends to continue engaging with the FDA while preparing a BLA and plans to present the complete dataset at a medical conference.
